Message:
drm/panel: simple: Add Microtips Technology 13-101HIEBCAF0-C panel

Add support for Microtips Technology USA 13-101HIECAF0-C 10.1",
1920x1200, 8-bit TFT LCD with LVDS interface, LED backlight and touch
support (ILITEK 2511).
